description: Gemini Tool Declarations for Day Trading Skill (NSE, Crypto & US)

tools.name: analyze_symbol
tools.description: Analyze an Indian stock (e.g. RELIANCE.NS, TCS.NS), cryptocurrency (e.g. BTC-USD, ETH-USD), or US stock for market data, news catalysts, setup trigger state, and entry/exit levels.

setup.description: Setup type to evaluate. 'orb' = 15-minute opening-range breakout, 'level' = key price level, 'daily' = daily closing pattern.

tools.name: scan_market
tools.description: Scan a configured market watchlist for day-trading setups (opening-range breakouts, 20-day high breakouts, bull flags, oversold bounces).

market.description: Market to scan: 'india' (NSE equities), 'crypto' (major crypto pairs), or 'us' (US equities).

setup.description: Scan mode: 'daily' (pre-market daily close setups) or 'orb' (intraday opening-range breakout).

limit.description: Maximum number of symbols to scan.

tools.name: backtest_strategy
tools.description: Backtest a trading setup using the Time Machine Monte Carlo simulation and historical replay. Replays 10,000 runs using the asset's own historical 5-minute bars.

replays.description: Number of Monte Carlo replay paths (default 10000).

tools.name: evaluate_risk
tools.description: Run deterministic pre-trade risk checks against account limits, stop-loss requirements, position caps, and market trading sessions.

tools.name: paper_trade
tools.description: Size a proposed day trade according to account budget and risk limits, run pre-trade validation, and generate a paper-trading bracket ticket.

execute.description: Whether to record a simulated paper fill in the local portfolio.

tools.name: get_market_clock
tools.description: Check whether an asset's exchange is currently open, regular session hours, local time, and exchange holiday schedule.

symbol.description: Symbol to check market hours for (e.g. 'RELIANCE.NS', 'BTC-USD', 'AAPL').
